title: MRI radiomics signature estimates breast cancer immune phenotype and treatment response
summary: A random forest on DCE-MRI radiomics features, trained on 94 TCIA patients with matched RNA-seq, estimated RNA-seq-derived tumor microenvironment phenotypes (immune-inflamed versus immune-desert) with an AUC of 0.855 (95% CI 0.777-0.932). The signature was tested in internal and two external sets, related to CD8 infiltration in a 158-patient cohort, and to response in 77 patients treated with anti-PD-1/PD-L1. The work is retrospective with a small training set.
ai_technology: Random forest radiomics signature trained on DCE-MRI features
organization: South China University of Technology; Guangdong Provincial People’s Hospital

evidence.tested: Internal validation, two independent external sets and an immunotherapy-treated cohort (n = 77).
evidence.unknown: Prospective validation as a response biomarker; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Predicts the RNA-defined phenotype from MRI features and is tested against treatment response.
